scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for every allowed n,k,p,t; separately implemented finite exact-rational checks are corroborative and not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous independent SI on a star, uniform index case, perfect fixed monitoring, k>=2, no recovery; not an empirical or general network theorem. Publication-priority overlap cannot be categorically excluded.
title: A universal deadline-independent sentinel ranking on stars and a sharp discrete-time reversal
